label: LO36.2
finding: Vertical LRPC, matching and structural natural-rate changes are covered by Hard. P52B-S1-LRPC-EL-001 incorrectly requires ever-larger inflation surprises: with a fixed unemployment gap and adaptive last-period expectations, a constant positive surprise implies ever-higher inflation. Some prompts hold unemployment below natural indefinitely but then assert a natural-rate endpoint without a policy change. Upper natural-rate/graph recognition can be strengthened.

label: LO36.3
finding: Hard already traces graph expectation adjustment and distinguishes adverse supply from demand movement. Two graph prompts infer expectations alone without excluding other SRPC shifters. Supply-shock feedback PM2A-EXP-LB-013 incorrectly borrows a temporary unemployment-gain explanation. Credibility is well covered; explicit rational-expectations terminology is absent, while adaptive expectations appears in a Hard checkpoint. Apply available-information reasoning within the selected credibility skill, without assuming perfect forecasting or adding a separate objective. Upper graph tasks often repeat simple readings.
